title: Volleyball: Jurado leads UST past CSB in Unity Cup opener
summary: Regina Jurado led University of Santo Tomas to a 25-21, 25-12, 25-18 sweep of College of Saint Benilde in their first game in the 2026 Shakey's Super League (SSL) Unity Cup on Saturday.
